t.zh: 价值算好了，接下来怎么走？很简单：每一步都走到四个邻居里价值最大的那一格。
t.en: The values are worked out. Now, which way to go? Simple: at every step, move to the neighbour with the largest value.

t.zh: 这一关有三个起点。每个起点，你都来替机器人一步一步地选。
t.en: This level has three starting points. From each one, you choose the robot’s moves step by step.

t.zh: 三个起点都走完以后，看看整张地图会长出什么。
t.en: Once all three are done, see what grows across the whole map.

goal.zh: 在价值已经算好的地图上，从三个起点各走到宝藏。每一步都要走到价值最大的邻居。
goal.en: On a map whose values are already worked out, walk from each of the three starting points to the treasure. Every step must go to the neighbour with the largest value.

how.zh: 点虚线框里的邻居，机器人就走过去。
how.en: Click a neighbour in a dashed frame and the robot moves there.

title.en: The value table is a satnav

body.zh: 每一格只看自己的邻居，却拼出了一张完整的导航图：从任何一格出发，顺着箭头走，都会绕开墙和陷阱，走到宝藏。
body.en: Each cell looks only at its own neighbours, yet together they make a complete navigation map: start anywhere, follow the arrows, and you will skirt the walls and traps and reach the treasure.

body.zh: 在强化学习里，这些箭头叫：到了一个状态，该做什么动作。先估价值，再顺着价值走，策略就自己长出来了。
body.en: In reinforcement learning these arrows are called a : in a given state, which action to take. Estimate the values first, then follow them, and the policy grows by itself.

note.zh: 策略 = 每一格都走向价值最大的邻居。
note.en: Policy = from every cell, head for the neighbour with the largest value.
